_source: Setting Primer 'Key dates', History and Timeline narrative and chronology. Present day is late 5029u (Basin year twelve). Basin reckoning: year = union - 5017.

events.text: The survey ship Dalton (Capt. Iolo Brandt) finds the gate.
Union quarantines the system; Calder Station built.
First probe returns with charts; Joaquim Reyes names the Basin.
Calder team identifies the lanes.
Unlicensed prospector Ashgrove runs the quarantine; never heard from again.
Third Committee debate opens.
IPS-N, Smith-Shimano and Harrison Armory chosen as partners; Battlegroup XI assigned.
Native-life clauses kept in the Charter.
Basin Charter approved; the crossing; the Closing on day 41; the pulse; the Anselm falls into Ostrom's star; the Landing on Tallis.
First Tallis landing fails; the Requisition; IPS-N crews take their ships and found the Free Lines (Halyard Station); 23 NHPs return unshackled.
Halloran seizes the Tallis grain stores; the 7th Marines mutiny; work begins on the Marrow; lattice first sampled on Scald.
The Armory garrison moves to Gloam (the Purview); the Ostrom Instrument.
The Returned decision; Absent machinery found under Tallis; Survey Office founded; Corvel breaks from Smith-Shimano; Saltmarsh Navy contract; Dunmore Rifles formed.
Growth Directive; Assay House chartered; Ostrom Standard founded; Riverlands Combine reorganized; Synod settles Pennant; the Gloam Understanding.

The Allotment opens (the Rush); Mercer-Ibarra takes Halvard's Rest; Coldwell Claims filed on Gloam; Ferrous Consolidated formed; first Navy attempt on the Exchange board; Corvel charts the Lantern Reach.
The Compact forms; WAYMARK enters the Deeps; first Verdance landing; Bellows settled.
Rimelight begins mining the Hollows; Absent shipyard found at Tarn; Stillwater settled; Verdance abandoned; first Navy attempt to put a council on Halvard's Rest.

Thaw riots on the Marrow (212 dead); first landing at Ashlar and quarantine; the Gap Accord; Corvel files on Pennant's southern continent; Cormorants vs Saltmarsh on Scald; second Verdance landing; second Navy attempt on the Exchange board.
The Glassfields War begins; killings at Dry Creek; the hull judgment; second Navy attempt on Halvard's Rest; Synod and Navy exchange fire over Pennant; second Verdance landing abandoned.

Kettle Flats; Purview troops reach Scald; siege of Sallow Ford; CARILLON refuses; Gallowglass boardings; chart war begins; Corvel lands on Pennant; Coldwell clearances; Cairn charted; Listeners attack a Kerr-Varga refinery.

Synod destroys Corvel's dropships and besieges the landing; Cormorants destroy a Basin Office tender at the Halyard mouth; Cairn sapience report; Kerr-Varga turns back Bench inspectors; Kasprzak unseen; the gate opens for nine seconds and releases a courier drone dated 5371u; Saltmarsh pulls 200 frames to the Marrow.
